parsed.summary: The PR addresses the issue of pickling figures with draggable legends by modifying the `offsetbox.py` file. It introduces a property for `canvas` to maintain picklability.

issues.description: The PR does not include any tests to verify that the fix works as expected. It is crucial to ensure that the change does not introduce any regressions or issues in other parts of the codebase.
